name: AUTH_020 - Should fail when OTP has wrong length (4 digits)
fullName: AUTH_020 - Should fail when OTP has wrong length (4 digits)

steps.name: request ("{ method: 'POST', url: 'https://dl-stg-api.finj.in/api/v1/auth/v'... 11 more characters, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mobileNumber: '7983748223', otp: '3456' }, failOnStatusCode: false, timeout: 30000 }")
